inspiration.observed_pattern: JSON document fields are exposed through generated columns, indexed together, and recomputed after payload updates.
inspiration.mysql_mariadb_translation: The fixture independently models shipment payloads with generated completion and status columns, a composite index, and two payload transitions before deterministic inspection.

fixture_notes: Generated columns expose a text completion flag and unquoted status text from each shipment payload; updates verify both values refresh together.
determinism_notes: Fixed event IDs and ordered output make generated-column refresh observable without clocks or randomness.
setup: CREATE TABLE shipment_events (event_id INT PRIMARY KEY, payload JSON NOT NULL, completed VARCHAR(4) AS (JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(payload, '$.complete'))), status_code VARCHAR(16) AS (JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(payload, '$.result'))), KEY idx_status_completed (status_code, completed))

steps.sql: UPDATE shipment_events SET payload = CASE event_id WHEN 31 THEN '{"complete":1,"result":"DELIVERED"}' WHEN 32 THEN '{"complete":0,"result":"RETRY"}' END WHERE event_id IN (31, 32)
SELECT event_id, completed, status_code FROM shipment_events ORDER BY event_id

checks.sql: SELECT event_id, payload FROM shipment_events ORDER BY event_id
